items.name: House Ball
items.downside: No scoring bonus; always available outside the deck.

items.name: Hook Ball
items.downside: Overcurves easily: a full charge can carry past the pocket.

items.name: Hammer Ball
items.downside: Hooks less than the House Ball.

items.name: Echo Ball
items.downside: Only the first pin it knocks down directly, once per roll; income and growth are not repeated.

items.name: Gold Pin
items.downside: Income is never retriggered.

items.name: Anchor Pin
items.downside: Heavier: harder to knock down, so strikes come less easily.

items.name: Grower Pin
items.downside: Pays off only over later frames; growth is lost if the pin is sold.

items.name: Rubber Pin
items.downside: Bouncier: scatters unpredictably.

items.name: Finisher
items.downside: Strikes only.

items.name: Spare Change
items.downside: Spares only.

items.name: Lone Survivor
items.downside: Only open frames ending with exactly one pin standing.

items.name: Hook Artist
items.downside: Needs a roll with qualifying charged spin.

items.name: House Favorite
items.downside: Every roll of the frame must use the House Ball.

items.name: Gold Rush
items.downside: Nothing without Gold pins.

items.name: Turkey Club
items.downside: From the third consecutive strike; any non-strike frame resets the streak.

items.name: Patient Investor
items.downside: Starts at +0 Mult; grows by 1 after each completed match.

items.name: Last Chance
items.downside: Only the second frame of a match.

items.name: Encore
items.downside: Nothing without retriggers.

items.name: Standing Order
items.downside: Nothing unless Anchor pins stay standing.

items.name: Dead Straight
items.downside: Charged spin is disabled for the match.

items.name: Clean Sweep
items.downside: Only strike and spare frames bank points.

items.name: Pin Counter
items.downside: Small on its own: only worth +10 Mult on a full clear, and a gutter frame gets nothing.

items.name: Hot Streak
items.downside: Nothing until the second strike in a row, and any spare or open frame resets the streak.

items.name: Last Stand
items.downside: Pays only for pins left standing, which pulls you away from strikes and spares.

items.name: Tip Jar
items.downside: Only $1, only on spares; no help to strike or standing builds.

items.name: Banana Ball
items.downside: Needs a curved strike; useless under Dead Straight and for straight builds.

items.name: Plumb Line
items.downside: Gives up curve: any curved roll in the frame cancels it, so it fights Hook builds.

items.name: Glass Pin
items.downside: Maintenance risk: one fall in five turns it into a Wood pin.

items.name: Glass Cutter
items.downside: Needs Glass pins in the rack, and every Glass fall risks turning it into Wood.

items.name: Crown Pin
items.downside: Zero Value unless it is the last pin to fall; rewards precise picking.

items.name: Split Specialist
items.downside: Pays only for hard conversions; easy spares and every strike get nothing.

items.name: Sweet Spot
items.downside: Rewards aim, not pins: a sloppy release on a strike still earns nothing.

items.name: Back Row
items.downside: Ignores the front of the rack; a pocket hit that leaves the corners gets little.

items.name: Underdog
items.downside: Only works when behind: a strong first frame switches it off for the match.

items.name: Crown Jewel
items.downside: Needs a Crown pin to fall last; otherwise an expensive empty slot.

items.name: Chalk Grip
items.downside: Nothing on strikes, so it competes with strike builds for the modification slot.

items.name: Spin Wax
items.downside: Straight frames earn nothing, so it pulls against Plumb Line and straight builds.

items.name: Coin Slot
items.downside: Money, not score: a strike with it banks no extra points.

items.name: Echo Charge
items.downside: Cannot charge an Echo Ball, and a glancing first contact wastes it.

items.name: Brass Cap
items.downside: Small, and only on a fall: a standing capped pin adds nothing.

items.name: Gilt Leaf
items.downside: Cannot gild a Gold pin, and it adds no score of its own.

items.name: Lantern
items.downside: Pays only when it survives the frame, so it fights strike builds.

items.name: Keystone
items.downside: Nothing while it stands; a split around it leaves an expensive slot empty.

items.name: House Rules
items.downside: Only the House Ball may be thrown in the boss match.

items.name: House Pins
items.downside: Every rack pin plays as plain Wood for the whole boss match.

items.name: House Oil
items.downside: No change: the standard oil pattern.

items.name: Dry Backend
items.downside: Curved throws hook harder after the oil ends.

items.name: Nudge
items.downside: One use per run, only before roll 2, and only into a spot whose pin has fallen.

items.name: Reserve Call
items.downside: Needs a pin in reserve, and lasts one frame.

items.name: Rule Waiver
items.downside: Only in boss matches, only for one frame, and exhausted after use.

items.name: Punch Card
items.downside: Only the first reroll of a visit, and it never lowers the price of anything you buy. Kept for the attempt; cannot be sold.

items.name: Pin Caddy
items.downside: Reserve pins do not score unless racked, so the slot only pays off with pin swaps or Reserve Call. Kept for the attempt; cannot be sold.

items.name: Clearance Tag
items.downside: Saves $1 per purchase; it needs several purchases before it has paid for itself. Kept for the attempt; cannot be sold.

items.name: Savings Book
items.downside: Only pays when you hold $20 or more at the end of a match, which competes with buying now. Kept for the attempt; cannot be sold.

items.name: Extra Shelf
items.downside: More choice, not cheaper choice: the extra offer costs full price and rerolls cost the same. Kept for the attempt; cannot be sold.

items.name: Spotlight Sign
items.downside: Rarer offers usually cost more, and common staples appear less often. Kept for the attempt; cannot be sold.

items.name: Head Pin
items.downside: Pays only for one pin: a frame that leaves the head pin standing gets nothing.

items.name: Wood Grain
items.downside: Every special pin you rack makes it weaker; it rewards keeping the plain House rack.

items.name: Opening Act
items.downside: Does nothing in a match's second frame, where comebacks are decided.

items.name: Open House
items.downside: Never helps a strike or a spare, and Clean Sweep banks open frames as 0.

items.name: Strike Fund
items.downside: Money only: it adds no points, so it needs the strikes before it pays.

items.name: Holdouts
items.downside: Rewards missing: it adds nothing to a strike or a spare.

items.name: Trophy Case
items.downside: Starts at +0 and grows only with strikes; worth little bought late.

items.name: Corner Pockets
items.downside: Two pins only, and the corners are the hardest pins to reach.

items.name: Late Rally
items.downside: Needs a bad first frame to pay, and does nothing in Practice, which has no target.

items.name: Clean Pickup
items.downside: Any curved roll in the frame cancels it, and it never helps a strike.

items.name: House Special
items.downside: Arming any special ball card cancels it for that frame.

items.name: Front Line
items.downside: Nothing for the back of the rack, where splits are left.

items.name: Spare Ball
items.downside: Hooks half as much as the House Ball, so it is a poor strike ball; nothing on a strike or an open frame.

items.name: Workhorse
items.downside: A small, steady bonus with no big payoff; lighter than the Hammer, so it carries less through the rack.

items.name: Oak Pin
items.downside: Heavier, so it falls less often and carries less into the pins behind it.

items.name: Tin Pin
items.downside: Half a Wood Pin's Value when it falls; it pays for the frames you do not clear.

items.name: Spare Jar
items.downside: Starts at +0 and grows only with spares; worth little bought late.

items.name: Consolation Prize
items.downside: Money only, and only for the frames you would rather not throw.
